print: Every page image of the 1985 Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal that shows each hymn 1-695. `scan`: hymnary.org's scan of the book, page by page at `url` ({page} its page); `withheld` lists the pages hymnary.org does not show; `copies` the pages it serves another page's scan for, so their own print is not shown either. `scans`: each scan page and the hymns printed on it. A hymn's start is read from its title number on a shown page (Vision OCR, checked against the blind readers' page lists). The hymns between two shown starts are put on every unshown page between them, inferred, not seen; a hymn a complete reading or a look at the page saw end on a shown page is not carried onto the unshown pages after it. `photos`: the owner's photos (data/photos/sdah-1985/) and the hymns each shows; `partial` the hymns the photos show only part of, and what they leave out. `lent`: a hymn whose page sends the singer to another hymn for its other stanzas, which that hymn's page decides. `engravings`: the SDAHImages engravings at the pinned commit and the hymn each shows; `revised` quotes an engraving's credit line where it dates a words revision after 1985. A hymn's deciding page is its photo, when the photos show it whole; else its scan, when every scan page of it is shown; else its engraving, unless revised; else none. A photo that shows part of a hymn stands beside its deciding page and rules the places it shows.
